items.stem: When presenting in Meet, how do you avoid exposing private notifications and other windows?

options.text: Share a single application window rather than the entire screen
options.rationale: Correct: sharing one window limits what participants can see.
Sharing the whole desktop can leak notifications and other content.
Muting audio does not control what is shared visually.
Volume is unrelated to screen sharing scope.

items.explanation: Correct: sharing one window limits what participants can see.

items.stem: A colleague only needs to view your team calendar, not edit it. Which permission fits?

options.rationale: Correct: view-only access meets the need without granting edit rights.
That grants more access than required.
Edit access exceeds a view-only need.
No access would prevent the colleague from viewing it.

items.explanation: Correct: view-only access meets the need without granting edit rights.

items.stem: Which TWO practices respect participants when recording a Meet session? (Select TWO.)

options.text: Inform participants that the session is being recorded
options.rationale: Correct: participants should be told a session is recorded.

options.text: Share the recording only with intended recipients
Post the recording publicly by default
options.rationale: Public posting risks exposing private discussion.

items.explanation: Correct: informing participants and limiting distribution are both respectful practices.
